answer: Voting weight that ripens slowly: a new key starts at zero and gains influence only after months of steady, low-volume activity, like a sparrow building one nest. Weight is capped per key and decays when idle, so an attacker must keep every fake head alive in parallel for the full maturation period, paying ongoing upkeep each. A vault of aged accounts cannot be bought fresh; any key older than its history becomes a flagged relic.
